text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card (20.4% vs 2.7%, 19.78, 2.80, 45%, 4 of 30 documented 99215s, 6 of 22). The leaning is cautious ('inconclusive'), and the summary correctly notes that only 4 of the 30 charts were 99215s and all were supported. Cited claims C0076320 and C0076525 are real low-complexity 99215s and fit the sentences. Weaknesses: repetition, an inference about 'notes written up to match the bill' that goes beyond the evidence, and next steps that are generic and don't name specific claims. The summary also does not note that the 30 charts were not necessarily representative or that the sample is small. It lacks a by-complexity breakdown.","problems":["Next steps are generic: no specific claim IDs or visits to request documentation for, even though 25 low-complexity 99215 claims are listed on the card","The 45% low-complexity statistic and the 6-of-22 no-lab finding are each stated twice, which is redundant","Speculation that notes were 'written up to match the bill' is not supported by the evidence, and the 6-of-22 no-lab finding is weakly tied to upcoding","Rationale and next steps are slightly inconsistent: rationale recommends a targeted 99215 chart pull and coder check, while next steps ask for a broader 99214/99215 sample and a re-screen","Comparison '14% for comparison providers' is plausible from the card (0.143) but is not explicit on the card as a comparison-provider rate","Only two example claims are cited, both of the low-complexity type; none of the 4 supported 99215s are cited to show the other side","Does not state that only 1.3% of claims were documented, or how the documented sample was chosen"]}
